We are looking for UC San Diego students interested in open EEG methods, data infrastructure, and computational neuroscience.

Volunteer Research Positions

Volunteer positions are usually linked to research projects. Students may contribute to EEG analysis, dataset curation, literature review, benchmarking, visualization, or reproducible workflows, depending on current project needs.

Paid Methods Positions

Paid positions are more closely linked to methods development and are usually at the Master 1 level. These roles require exceptional evidence of technical maturity, especially a strong GitHub account with meaningful code contributions.

Apply

To apply, email arno@ucsd.edu. Include your UC San Diego affiliation, the type of position you are seeking, your research or methods interests, and a link to your GitHub account if you are applying for a paid methods position.
